study: Small-ROI robustness of on-board first-order CT metrics
research_question: How do HEEH-V1 on-board first-order CT statistics and radiomics features within a centered circular ROI on the mid axial slice change as the ROI radius shrinks from 36 mm to 8 mm, and does the application's exact first-order agreement with PyRadiomics v3.0.1 (tolerance 1e-6) hold at every tested ROI size?

roi.type: centered circular cylinder on one 2D axial slice
roi.center: volume center pixel (row = n_rows/2 - 0.5, col = n_cols/2 - 0.5)
roi.physical_basis: DICOM PixelSpacing (row, column spacing) via SimpleITK

stability_criterion.definition: population std of the across-radius values / abs(mean) of those values
stability_criterion.interpretation: feature is called radius-stable when CV <= threshold

boundary_notes: The in-app radiomics ROI call analyzes ROI voxel values; texture families (GLCM/GLRLM/GLSZM/GLDM/NGTDM) require a 2D finite image and are not part of this ROI sweep (feature_coverage boundary).
PyRadiomics agreement is matched first-order only, same as the recorded project evaluations.
The ROI is a defined geometric region, not a clinical lesion; no diagnostic meaning is attached to any measured value.
